title: Preliminary certificate check
statement: Let $N$ be a finite nondeterministic Turing machine with Boolean tape symbols, and let $n,s\in\mathbb{N}$ and $w$ be a finite Boolean string. The predicate holds exactly when $w$ has length $W(N)(2s+1)+w_P(n)+1$, its bit at position $W(N)(2s+1)+w_P(n)$ (using `false` if that position is out of range) is true, and the natural number encoded by the length-$w_P(n)$ segment of $w$ beginning at position $W(N)(2s+1)$ is at most $n+1$.
hypotheses_covered: A finite nondeterministic Turing machine $N$ with Boolean tape symbols
